_meta.description: Maps cTrader pair keys (as used elsewhere in this project, e.g. config.broker_symbol_key output) to the exact asset name shown on the Binomo trading terminal. binomo_executor.py only trades pairs present in BOTH this map and the live cTrader symbol list - anything missing here is silently skipped, never guessed.
_meta.how_to_verify: Log into the Binomo terminal yourself, open each asset, and copy its exact displayed name (and data-testid/aria-label from the DOM if available) into this file. Do this BEFORE running --correlation-check, since a wrong name here means the executor searches for an asset that doesn't exist and safely does nothing (see binomo_executor.py's 'don't guess a selector' rule) - better to fail closed, but you won't get any data until the names are right.
_meta.otc_warning: Binomo often trades the same underlying pair under an OTC name on weekends/off-hours (e.g. 'EUR/USD OTC') on its own synthetic feed - this is a DIFFERENT price series from cTrader's. otc_name is tracked separately so correlation-check can flag OTC sessions instead of silently comparing two unrelated feeds.
